threads.body: This handler also emits `gen_ai.client.invoke_agent.exception` for failures in local response processing. For example, a UTF-8 character split across response chunks causes the local `.decode("utf-8")` to raise `UnicodeDecodeError` even though the SDK call and stream iteration succeeded. Restrict event emission to exceptions from the SDK call or stream iterator, excluding local decoding and attribute processing.

Bedrock supplies that proof here, and the Azure and Assistants READMEs explicitly say their error handlers are unexercised. I'm not adding per-SDK negative cases or additional event expectations in this stack.

We're not limiting this event to exceptions thrown by the four SDK calls, so the broader handler and processing-failure tests are intentional.
